snippet.title: Sound Studio Content Update | New Club Penguin
snippet.description:
Get ready to jam out and rock on with a new DJ Cadence genre in the Soundstudio minigame, only on NewCP!

Log on and create some music over at:
https://play.newcp.net

Check out what's new on New Club Penguin on our blog:
https://www.newcp.net/blog

Join our Discord Community:
https://discord.gg/clubpenguin

Subscribe to New Club Penguin on YouTube: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9AgwsxIohdFFCL8p84iwKQ?sub_confirmation=1

Follow us on Twitter: 
https://twitter.com/newcIubpenguin

Follow us on TikTok: 
https://www.tiktok.com/@officialnewcp
